normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Private pool **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1 through May 1 for $35 per day**- 5 adult bikes- Low-Speed Vehicle- Gas firepit- Grill- Elevator- Pet-friendly- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Everyone will be on Cloud Nine when staying in this 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom Dune Allen beach home that sleeps 17. Guests will love walking to the beach and will feel pampered by amenities, including a large private pool, gas fire pit, putting green, elevator, SONOS sound system, and 3 balconies.Cloud Nine’s decor is a luxurious fisherman’s delight. Shells, sealife sculpture, and a deer skull intertwine with natural finishes to create a comfortable, relaxing space suited to the home’s quiet wooded views. Guests staying on the first floor may select between 3 guest bedrooms. A guest bedroom has 2 queen beds, a flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom with a shower. A second guest bedroom has an upholstered king bed, flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. A third guest bedroom has a king bed, leather armchair, flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom with a shower. A door from the hallway opens to a covered porch and outdoor patio. A gas grill and shaded dining table make it easy to enjoy lunch while taking a break from swimming in the pool or relaxing in the sitting spa. A cornhole game and a gas firepit provide guests with spaces to chat and play long after the sun has set. A guest bedroom and an open living, dining, and kitchen are on the second floor. Home chefs will love the premium Wolf appliances and ample counter space in the gourmet kitchen. A dine-in kitchen counter seats 5, and a walk-in pantry has plenty of room for dry goods. A wall of gleaming fish defines the dining table, which seats 8. 2 full-size sofas and armchairs surround a teak root table and an 85’ flat-screen TV with a SONOS sound system. French doors off the living area open to a balcony with views of the neighborhood. A guest bedroom tucked behind the living area has a king bed and a private bathroom with a shower. A spacious primary bedroom has an upholstered king bed, an armchair with a side table, and a 65’ flat-screen TV on the third floor. French doors open to a balcony with views of the neighborhood. The bedroom’s private bathroom has a serene soaking tub and separate shower. A guest bedroom has a full-over-full bunk bed with a twin trundle and a private bathroom with a shower. French doors from the bedroom also opens to the balcony. Guests can ride to dinner at nearby Stinky’s Fish Camp or explore 30A’s bike path on 5 included adult bikes. The home will book quickly with Cloud Nine’s Dune Allen Beach location, pool, elevator, and luxurious finishes. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 17):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Full over Full Bunk Bed with Twin Trundle, Private Bathroom With Shower Only*This home is pet-friendly with an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400 plus tax.*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
